description: A photo gallery with a dialog for the selected picture. Additive to Photo gallery.

files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  Photos in a grid, a masonry of mixed heights, or a featured picture over thumbnails, with a dialog that shows
  the selected photo. Static markup: the dialog open state is a prop. Axes: layout (grid, masonry, featured),
  captions (show, hide), lightbox (open, closed).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { LightboxLabels } from "./lightbox-gallery.types";
  import type { Photo } from "./photo-gallery.types";

  export type LightboxGalleryProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    photos: Photo[];
    empty?: string;
    labels: LightboxLabels;
    layout?: "grid" | "masonry" | "featured";
    captions?: "show" | "hide";
    lightbox?: "open" | "closed";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../compose/Box.svelte";
  import Button from "../compose/Button.svelte";
  import Group from "../compose/Group.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../icons/LucideIcon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.svelte";
  import FigureBlock from "../components/figure-block.svelte";
  import LightboxStage from "../components/lightbox-stage.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    photos,
    empty = "",
    labels,
    layout = "grid",
    captions = "show",
    lightbox = "closed",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: LightboxGalleryProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame id={id} title={title} lead={lead} landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}>
  {#if ((photos?.length ?? 0) === 0)}
    <EmptyState icon="image" title={empty} />
  {:else}
    {#if ((layout as string) === "featured")}
      <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" data-testid="featured">
        <MediaFrame alt={title} />
        <Group gap="4" align="center" justify="between">
          <Stack gap="0">
            <Text size="base" weight="semibold">
              {photos[0]?.title ?? ""}
            </Text>
            <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
              {tpl(labels.counter, 1, (photos?.length ?? 0))}
            </Text>
          </Stack>
          <Group gap="2">
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" layout="icon" type="button" aria-label={labels.previous}>
              <LucideIcon name="chevron-left" size={16} />
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" layout="icon" type="button" aria-label={labels.next}>
              <LucideIcon name="chevron-right" size={16} />
            </Button>
          </Group>
        </Group>
        <Box class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-9" data-testid="thumbs">
          {#each photos as p, i (p.id)}
            <MediaFrame alt={p.title} ratio="1/1" class={((i === 0) ? "ring-2 ring-foreground" : "")} />
          {/each}
        </Box>
      </Stack>
    {:else}
      <Box
        class={
          (layout as string) === "masonry" ? "columns-1 gap-4 sm:columns-2 lg:columns-3"
          : "grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3"
        }
        data-testid="items"
      >
        {#each photos as p, i (p.id)}
          <FigureBlock
            class={cn(
              "relative flex flex-col gap-2",
              (((layout as string) === "masonry") ? "mb-4 break-inside-avoid" : "")
            )}
            testid="item"
          >
            <MediaFrame
              alt={p.title}
              ratio={
                (layout as string) === "masonry" ? ((p.size === "tall") ? "3/4" : ((p.size === "wide") ? "16/9" : ((p.size === "large") ? "4/3" : "1/1")))
                : "4/3"
              }
            />
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"
              layout="icon"
              type="button"
              class="absolute right-2 top-2 bg-background"
              aria-label={labels.open}
              data-testid="open"
            >
              <LucideIcon name="arrow-up-right" size={16} />
            </Button>
            {#if (((captions as string) === "show") && (((layout as string) === "grid") || ((layout as string) === "masonry")))}
              <Box class="text-sm text-muted-foreground" data-testid="caption">
                {p.title}
              </Box>
            {/if}
          </FigureBlock>
        {/each}
      </Box>
    {/if}
    <LightboxStage photos={photos} labels={labels} captions={captions} lightbox={lightbox} />
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
